articles.content: STORY: Meta Platforms on Wednesday announced another step toward personalizing user content — by tapping into people's conversations with its generative AI tools.Starting December 16, user interactions with the company's AI features will be added to existing data such as likes and follows to shape recommendations for ads and content, including on its Facebook and Instagram apps.For example, a user talking about hiking with Meta AI could later be shown hiking groups, friends’ trail updates or ads for boots.Users will be notified of the change starting October 7—and they will not have an option to opt out, though the update applies only to those who use Meta AI.Meta says it won’t use conversations about sensitive topics—like religion, health, or politics—for ad targeting.The move comes as other tech giants, including Google and Amazon, have begun monetizing AI tools, often through cloud-based services.But few have used AI chat interactions to personalize content and ads across multiple platforms at the scale Meta is attempting.The tech giant has 1 billion monthly active users across the company’s family of apps.

articles.title: Meta launches smart glasses, gets set for 'superintelligence'
articles.content: STORY: Meta has launched its latest smart glasses, and they are its first consumer-ready spectacles with a built in display.Boss Mark Zuckerberg presented the new gadget at the firm’s annual event for developers in California on Wednesday (September 17).Though the tech sometimes let him down:“That’s too bad, I don’t know what happened”.The new gadget is dubbed the Meta Ray-Ban Display, and will go on sale later this month priced from $799.It features a small digital display in the right lens for basic tasks such as notifications. The display is large enough to watch a video or read a thread of messages. It appears in one eye it's slightly off center, so it doesn't block your view and it disappears after a few seconds when it's not in use so it doesn't distract you.”But Zuckerberg is planning for a day when smart glasses can do much more.He says they are the perfect device for interacting with so-called “superintelligence” - that’s AI that exceeds human capability: Glasses are the ideal form factor for personal superintelligence, because they let you stay present in the moment while getting access to all of these AI capabilities that make you smarter, help you communicate better, improve your memory, improve your senses, and more.”Meta has enjoyed some commercial success with earlier versions of its smart glasses, which also got updates Wednesday.But it’s widely seen as trailing rivals like OpenAI and Alphabet in developing AI systems.The company has been recruiting aggressively in a bid to close that gap.One analyst told Reuters that Meta still had work to do in convincing people that smart glasses are a gadget they need.But he said there was scope for it to grab a big share of the market for such devices.
